correctness.rationale: Exact full-vertex reduced Świątkowski complex is mathematically justified by arXiv:1708.02351. Exhaustive weight-three integer matrices have chain dimensions 1771,6468,7644,2912, compositions zero; unimodular unit pivots yield Smith invariants \(\partial_1:1^{1770}\), \(\partial_2:1^{4689},2\), and \(\partial_3:1^{2911}\). Rank-one residual proportionality and gcd two checked exactly; degree-three result replicated with distinct pivot orders. Since the degree-three cokernel has no torsion, \(H_2\cong\mathbb Z^{43}\), with other integral homology groups calculated too.

value.rationale: This is the complete natural integral homology invariant of the canonical Fano incidence graph three-particle configuration space. It closes the substantively motivated large-prime torsion gap left by previously published field computations and gives a robust exact integer benchmark; it is not a routine reformulation of ranks over characteristics two and three.
